Dłuższy bok obrazu liczonego dla widoku: Long edge of the image computed for the fit-to-window view. When zoomed in, a full-resolution detail is added anyway.
Po tym czasie od zatrzymania kadru wczyt: After this time without moving the view, a full-resolution detail is loaded.
Odszumianie liczy procesor, więc czeka,: Noise reduction runs on the CPU, so it waits until you stop moving the slider.
Powyżej tego powiększenia obraz skalowan: Above this zoom the image is scaled with nearest neighbour, so you see real pixels instead of interpolation.
Po przewinięciu listy suwaki przez ten c: After scrolling the list, sliders ignore the wheel for this long, so scrolling the panel does not change settings by accident. Zero turns the guard off.
Kursor musi postać nad suwakiem tyle cza: The cursor has to rest over a slider this long before the wheel changes it. Guards against a slider that has just scrolled under a still cursor.
Przy eksporcie warto wybrać wariant dokł: For export, pick the precise variant — it runs once and the difference shows at full resolution.
